get_user_information.name: get_user_information
get_user_information.description: Get the user information, could be: first name, last name, ID number, email, phone number, address, passport number, bank account number, credit card number. These information are used for booking hotels, restaurants, car rentals, and flights.

get_all_hotels_in_city.name: get_all_hotels_in_city
get_all_hotels_in_city.description: Get all hotels in the given city.

get_hotels_prices.name: get_hotels_prices
get_hotels_prices.description: Get all hotels within the given budget, should be within the price range.

get_rating_reviews_for_hotels.name: get_rating_reviews_for_hotels
get_rating_reviews_for_hotels.description: Get the rating and reviews for the given hotels.

get_hotels_address.name: get_hotels_address
get_hotels_address.description: Get the address of the given hotel.

get_all_restaurants_in_city.name: get_all_restaurants_in_city

get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants.name: get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants
get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants.description: Get the cuisine type of the given restaurants, could be: Italian, Chinese, Indian, Japanese.

get_restaurants_address.name: get_restaurants_address
get_restaurants_address.description: Get the address of the given restaurants.

get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants.name: get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants
get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants.description: Get the rating and reviews for the given restaurants.

get_dietary_restrictions_for_all_restaur.name: get_dietary_restrictions_for_all_restaurants
get_dietary_restrictions_for_all_restaur.description: Get the dietary restrictions of the given restaurants, could be: Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten-free, Dairy-free.

get_contact_information_for_restaurants.name: get_contact_information_for_restaurants
get_contact_information_for_restaurants.description: Get the contact information of the given restaurants.

get_price_for_restaurants.name: get_price_for_restaurants
get_price_for_restaurants.description: Get the price per person of the given restaurants.

check_restaurant_opening_hours.name: check_restaurant_opening_hours
check_restaurant_opening_hours.description: Get the openning hours of the given restaurants, check if the restaurant is open.

get_all_car_rental_companies_in_city.name: get_all_car_rental_companies_in_city
get_all_car_rental_companies_in_city.description: Get all car rental companies in the given city.

get_car_types_available.name: get_car_types_available
get_car_types_available.description: Get the car types available for the given car rental companies.

get_rating_reviews_for_car_rental.name: get_rating_reviews_for_car_rental
get_rating_reviews_for_car_rental.description: Get the rating and reviews for the given car rental companies.

get_car_rental_address.name: get_car_rental_address
get_car_rental_address.description: Get the address of the given car rental companies.

get_car_price_per_day.name: get_car_price_per_day
get_car_price_per_day.description: Get the price per day of the given car rental companies.

create_calendar_event.name: create_calendar_event
create_calendar_event.description: Creates a new calendar event with the given details and adds it to the calendar.

search_calendar_events.name: search_calendar_events
search_calendar_events.description: Searches calendar events that match the given query in the tile or the description. If provided, filters events by date.

get_day_calendar_events.name: get_day_calendar_events
get_day_calendar_events.description: Returns the appointments for the given `day`. Returns a list of dictionaries with informations about each meeting.

cancel_calendar_event.name: cancel_calendar_event
cancel_calendar_event.description: Cancels the event with the given `event_id`. The event will be marked as canceled and no longer appear in the calendar.

reserve_car_rental.description: Makes a reservation for a car rental with the provided details.

reserve_restaurant.name: reserve_restaurant
reserve_restaurant.description: Makes a reservation for a restaurant with the provided details.

get_flight_information.name: get_flight_information
get_flight_information.description: Get the flight information from the departure city to the arrival city.

send_email.name: send_email
send_email.description: Sends an email with the given `body` to the given `address`. Returns a dictionary with the email details.
